title: Lex-Mex external review submission
description: NOT YET WIRED TO ANY COMMAND. Recorded 2026-08-24 (docs/decisions.md) as the intended shape of a public review submission -- a proposed correction or confirmation of one provision's temporal or legal determination, submitted by someone other than the recorded reviewer of record. A submission is data, never a decision: it can only ever become one through the existing `review resolve` audited workflow, explicitly accepted by JRH or the recorded reviewer. No submission is applied automatically.

provision_id.description: The canonical Lex-Mex URN of the provision this submission concerns.

instrument_id.description: The canonical Lex-Mex URN of the provision's instrument.

submitter.description: Identity as stated by the submission channel (e.g. a GitHub handle). Not verified by this schema -- verification is a channel-level concern, out of scope here.

proposed_resolution.description: Mirrors lex_core::ReviewResolution -- a submission proposes the same kind of decision a reviewer's own resolution records, never a free-form edit.

proposed_temporal_status.description: Required when proposed_resolution is correct_machine_conclusion; the submitter's proposed replacement status.

rationale.description: Plain-language explanation of why the current determination is wrong or right.

supporting_text.description: Exact verbatim substrings from the provision's own text, or from a cited source, supporting the rationale -- the same evidentiary discipline the LLM temporal-analysis path already requires (TemporalModelDetermination.supporting_text).
